newsitem.title: GERMANY: Triumph Adler to up 96 dividend to 9 marks.
newsitem.headline: Triumph Adler to up 96 dividend to 9 marks.

text.p: German consumer products group Triumph Adler AG said on Wednesday it planned to pay a dividend of nine marks per share for 1996, up 50 pfennigs on the previous year's figure of 8.50 marks.

The group said in a compulsory statement that 1996 sales grew to 1.246 billion marks from 1.138 marks, while earnings per share by the DVFA analysts' method grew to 11.52 marks from 10.96 marks the previous year.

The group said it would propose the increased dividend at its forthcoming annual shareholders meeting, while it would give more detailed information on its 1996 results at its annual news conference on May 12.
